Technical SEO.title: Search News Buzz Video Recap: Google Scaled Content Abuse From Facebook, ChatGPT Search 20% Of Google & More
Technical SEO.summary: The weekly recap covers Facebook's AI-generated content strategy likely to be flagged under Google's scaled content abuse policy, and notes that important URLs can still appear in Google Search even after returning a 400 status code.

Technical SEO.title: Google Shopping Dominating The European Product Search Results
Technical SEO.summary: Following Google's removal of free product listings in Europe due to the Digital Markets Act, BrightEdge data shows Google Shopping now appears 16 to 35 times more often than the next competitor in European product search results.

Technical SEO.title: Google Confirms Issues With Merchant Center, API & Feeds
Technical SEO.summary: Google confirmed an ongoing incident affecting the Merchant API, Merchant Center, and Feeds, as posted on the Google Merchant Center status page.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: 4 Datasets On AI Visibility: ChatGPT Sends 0.62% Of Google's Organic Traffic
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The article presents four datasets on AI visibility, including the finding that ChatGPT sends 0.62% of Google's organic traffic volume, and argues that AI visibility budgets can be made defensible by measuring exposure, recall, and consideration alongside dashboard scores.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Brave Sells Its Search Index To AI, And Your Website Is Probably In It
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Brave is selling its search index to AI companies including Cohere, Mistral, and Perplexity, and a site-search tool lets publishers check whether their pages are included in that index.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: ChatGPT's paid traffic is worth far less than Google's
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Paid visits from ChatGPT generated 89 cents in revenue per session, compared with $2.45 per session from paid Google Search, highlighting a significant monetization gap between the two platforms.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Scrunch vs. Ahrefs: AI visibility tracking comparison
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The piece compares Scrunch and Ahrefs as AI visibility tracking tools, aimed at marketers evaluating platforms for monitoring brand presence in AI-generated search results.

AI Search / GEO.title: OpenAI Working On ChatGPT Tools For Business For Analytics & Citations
AI Search / GEO.summary: OpenAI is developing a Search Console-style tool that will allow businesses to claim their presence in ChatGPT and track their performance, including analytics and citation data, within the platform.

AI Search / GEO.title: ChatGPT builds mention and click charts for verified businesses
AI Search / GEO.summary: ChatGPT is building mention and click reporting charts specifically for verified businesses, signaling a move toward measurable brand visibility within the AI search environment.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google AI Mode Asking Searchers To Continue With This Search
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google is now prompting users who start a query in AI Mode to continue their search within that surface, a behavioral nudge designed to increase AI Mode engagement and ad impressions.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google Pushing AI Mode Users To Opt In To Personal Intelligence
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google is displaying pop-up prompts inside AI Mode encouraging users to enable Personal Intelligence, a feature that personalizes search responses, via a dedicated configuration flow.

AI Search / GEO.title: Bing Search AI Visual Summary Snippet
AI Search / GEO.summary: Microsoft Bing has launched an AI Visual Summary feature that appends a button to individual search snippets and, when clicked, generates an AI-produced graphic summarizing the linked page's content.

AI Search / GEO.title: What Actually Gets You Cited in AI Search (2026 Data)
AI Search / GEO.summary: A data study examines the factors that determine which pages receive citations in AI-powered search results, providing 2026 research findings on AI citation ranking signals.
